note: Simple Image Rotate adds a 'Rotate image clockwise' button to core image field widgets; the rotation is applied to the file on entity save (hook_entity_presave rewrites it to an _r<n> name, idempotent). It has NO settings page and NO config object; rotation is enabled per image field via the third-party setting simple_image_rotate.enable_rotate (boolean) on the field's FieldConfig, and the button also requires the 'rotate images' permission. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real third-party setting on image fields on the Article content type (namespaced field_sir_*); each case creates/inspects/toggles the enable_rotate setting and cleans up its own fields. (Role/permission cases are avoided: this shared site currently cannot rebuild its router — an unrelated gdpr/workbench_moderation issue makes role saves throw — so the 'rotate images' permission side is documented but not used in a live case.)

evals.prompt: How do I turn on image rotation for an image field with the simple_image_rotate module, and what else does a user need to see the rotate button?
evals.expected_output: On the image field's edit form tick 'Enable rotate function', which stores the third-party setting simple_image_rotate.enable_rotate = true on the field's FieldConfig. The 'Rotate image clockwise' button then appears for users who also have the 'rotate images' permission.

evals.prompt: When an editor rotates an image with simple_image_rotate, when and how is the actual image file changed?
evals.expected_output: The JS rotates only the preview and records an angle; on entity save hook_entity_presave() moves the file to a new _r<counter> filename, rotates the real image via the image factory, updates width/height/filesize, and resets the angle to 0 (so it is idempotent).

evals.prompt: Which fields does simple_image_rotate work on, does it have a settings page, and what does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: It works only on core image fields and depends on the core Image module. It has no settings page (configure is null) and no config object — it is enabled per image field via the enable_rotate third-party setting, plus the 'rotate images' permission.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has an image field with simple_image_rotate rotation enabled. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_sir_known: its FieldConfig on node.article carries third_party_settings.simple_image_rotate.enable_rotate = true.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has two image fields, field_sir_on and field_sir_off. Exactly one has simple_image_rotate rotation enabled. Inspect the live configuration and say which one.
evals.expected_output: field_sir_on has rotation enabled: its FieldConfig has third_party_settings.simple_image_rotate.enable_rotate = true, whereas field_sir_off does not.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has an image field field_sir_task. Using simple_image_rotate, enable the rotate function on that field, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the third-party setting on the field's FieldConfig: FieldConfig::loadByName('node','article','field_sir_task')->setThirdPartySetting('simple_image_rotate','enable_rotate',TRUE)->save() (or tick 'Enable rotate function' on the field edit form). Verified by enable_rotate === true on field_sir_task.

evals.prompt: I want my editors to be able to rotate the photos they upload to the 'Photo' image field (field_sir_photo) on Articles. Turn on the rotate feature for that field on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the rotate function on the field_sir_photo image field by setting third_party_settings.simple_image_rotate.enable_rotate = true on its FieldConfig (via the field edit form's 'Enable rotate function' checkbox or in code). (Editors also need the 'rotate images' permission to see the button.) Verified by enable_rotate === true on field_sir_photo.
